I am a farmer here in Morogoro with a small plot of beans, just 0.15 hectares. The rains here come twice but the soil is tired, and chemical fertilizer is expensive — beans also fix their own nitrogen, so I do not waste money on urea for them. I will use the seeds I saved from last season like my neighbors do, and put some manure from my few animals to help the soil. My wife and older children will help me weed and harvest, so I do not need to hire anyone for such a small plot.
